title: More options for text, images, and tools
summary:
Five text models joined the list, from image-capable GPT-5 Nano to DeepSeek R1 0528, alongside a few model configuration updates.

GPT-5 Nano and Claude 3.5 Haiku were added to the text model list. Both support tools, and GPT-5 Nano accepts image input alongside text.

OpenAI o3 and DeepSeek R1 0528 joined the text model list, with DeepSeek R1 0528 routed through Bedrock.

Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite was added. The same PR added upstream identifiers for nova-fast and roblox-rp, plus cached-input pricing for nova-fast.

highlights.title: GPT-5 Nano added
highlights.text: GPT-5 Nano accepts text and image input and supports tools. [Find GPT-5 Nano](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=GPT-5%20Nano).

highlights.title: DeepSeek R1 0528 added
highlights.text: DeepSeek R1 0528 joins the text model list as a reasoning model. [Find DeepSeek R1 0528](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=DeepSeek%20R1%200528).
